name: 13 Clues
summary: Each player must deduce the three cards clipped to their own screen — one Person, Location and Weapon — before anyone else does.
rules_text: Remove suits per player count and set aside Secret Informant cards lettered A-H. Split remaining cards into Person, Location, Weapon piles, shuffle each, deal one of each face down to each player, then shuffle the rest together and deal two more face down each. Each player looks at their five cards, secretly chooses one Person, one Location, one Weapon and passes them face down to the left neighbor to clip face-out on that neighbor's screen so the owner cannot see them. Their remaining two cards stay hidden behind their own screen. On your turn you gain a Magnifying Glass if you have none, then spend all you have for actions: Question a Witness by giving the glass to a chosen player and asking how many cards of one suit or one category (Male/Female, Indoor/Outdoor, Up-close/Ranged) they see in all other screens plus their own hidden hand; Consult a Secret Informant by giving the glass to the poorest player and secretly peeking one informant card; or Make an Accusation naming a Person, Location and Weapon not visible to you. If the three match your screen you win, otherwise your turn ends.
